decision.justification: Two independent views of this merchant disagree with its declaration. The storefront presents a different business, and the telemetry channel agrees. Neither could have produced the other: a merchant cannot change its payment behaviour without changing its actual business, and cannot change its interface without changing what customers see.

attribution.label: Round-value share drift (vs category)
attribution.explains: Recent minus prior window. Separates a merchant that has always priced in round numbers from one that started last month.

attribution.label: Volume trend slope (vs category)
attribution.explains: Fitted daily growth rate of transaction count.

attribution.label: Chargeback rate drift (vs category)
attribution.explains: Change in chargeback rate between windows.

attribution.label: Post-peak persistence (vs category)
attribution.explains: Volume after the peak divided by volume before it. Near 1.0 means a spike that decayed -- a sale. Well above 1.0 means a step change that held.

attribution.label: Peak-to-median volume ratio (vs category)
attribution.explains: Largest single day relative to the median day.

narrative.text: Merchant MID100086 declared apparel at onboarding 508 days ago. Telemetry dissents: the largest deviations from the apparel baseline are round_share_drift at +12.0 sigma (observed 0.221 against a category baseline of -0.00315), chargeback_drift at +7.3 sigma (observed 0.0182 against a category baseline of -2e-05), post_peak_persistence at +3.3 sigma (observed 1.43 against a category baseline of 1.05). The checkout surface presents a unlicensed_lending interface at 0.99 confidence, against a declared category of apparel. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. Asked directly, the merchant restated its declared business. In total 3 independent views of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 4 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier restricts settlements, corroborated by the telemetry channel; the storefront alone would not have been sufficient.
